classes.text: OR gate: a circle with a vertical input bar on its left side where the input lines end.
AND gate: a small square box with a vertical input bar on its left side where the input lines end.
Coincidence gate: a square box with a fraction such as A/B or 2/3 written inside, with a vertical input bar.
NOT gate: a square with an X drawn across it.
ON DELAY timer: a small box with one rounded end and the word ON inside.
OFF DELAY timer: a small box with one rounded end and the word OFF inside.
PULSE: a square with a pulse waveform (a raised step) drawn inside.
S-R memory: two small square cells stacked vertically, with the letter S in the top cell and R in the bottom cell.
Latch memory: two small square cells stacked vertically, with the letters L and R.
Toggle memory: three small square cells stacked vertically, with the letters S, T and R.
Isolation function: a wide rectangle with the word ISO inside.
Flasher: a wide rectangle with the word FLASHER inside.
Power-up pulse unit: a wide rectangle with the word PUPF inside.
Indicator light (lamp): a circle with one letter (R, G, O, Y or W) inside and four short rays at its corners.
Continuation on the same drawing: a short arrow-shaped (pentagon) box with a notch on one end and a single number inside.
Continuation to another drawing: a long arrow-shaped box containing a drawing number such as 700-J158-010 and a sheet number.
Manual input: a small open circle (or a filled dot) at the very start of a signal line, with the control switch tag (such as HS-0111 ...) written above the line.
Process input: a small arrow head on a line, next to an instrument tag.
MMIS hardwired input/output: a small filled black square on a line.
MMIS data communication input/output: a small filled black diamond on a line.
Alarm: a circle with an alarm code over a number (such as UA over 001), often inside a square.
System block: a large rectangle with the name of a plant system written inside (for example REACTOR REGULATING SYSTEM).
None of these: text, a table cell, a junction dot, an empty area between wires, or only part of a symbol.
